description: Add an EXISTING rate to a tax group, or change that rate’s compounding flag within the group. Both ids come from get_taxes. This shares the rate — it does not copy it. The group starts charging the rate’s existing per-outlet percentages, and a later edit to that rate changes this group too. Use create_tax_rate instead when the rate does not exist yet. The rate is appended last in the charging order; use update_tax_group with rateIdsInOrder to move it. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT — this immediately adds tax to every product in the group. Sales already rung up are NOT recalculated — this only affects sales from now on.

compounding.description: Charge this rate on the running total including the rates above it. Default false

taxRateId.description: Tax rate id from get_taxes — an existing rate, shared not copied

name: hub_add_tax_rate_to_group
title: Add rate to group
